data.title: bn-342ek: unsigned local intent.accept held to the admitted actor and daemon clock; stale schema/IDL prose

data.body: [INFO][risk:high] No security finding. Failure modes: actor or timestamp spoofing returns AcceptanceChainInvalid, and a missing clock returns UnsupportedSemanticFeature before registry mutation; the imported-bundle arm remains separately chain-verified at intent.rs:427-460. Edge cases: signed, unsigned, protocol-before-3.8, imported, mismatched actor, mismatched time, and clockless paths were traced. Rollback: revert e79f7e2e9e8f06055bf10ea0ecedaecc69b9b7bb; this range changes no wire shape or stored identity. Monitoring: count intent.accept AcceptanceChainInvalid and UnsupportedSemanticFeature outcomes, correlated to daemon audit records. Validation: static review covered the full persisted nine-file range and supporting admission, clock, signing, serialization, and mutation paths; tests were inspected but not run because reviewer scope permits only Seal metadata writes. The risk:critical human-approval gate remains separate.

data.reason: LGTM for 3e53d9e2b6677a8d6e1b1d55d17fa38a3b4ba58c..e79f7e2e9e8f06055bf10ea0ecedaecc69b9b7bb. The shared pre-mutation check binds every local acceptance to call.grant.actor and Services::now, while bundle acceptance remains chain-verified. No security blockers found. The risk:critical human gate remains required.
Informational risk:high assessment; no finding or requested change.
